payload.title: Continuous background automation for Papyrus sites
payload.description:
Papyrus sites increasingly run work by themselves, unattended: the weekly knowledge run (PPY-dca7cd), reader snapshots, and next the trend-story pipeline (PPY-fb4dfa) and AI drafting. Before more automation is built on the Tactus procedures, clean up how procedures are packaged, named, registered and run, so any procedure can run as a scheduled background job from the published package, for any site, including site-supplied procedures.

Children are the procedure chores filed 2026-10-23, plus the story that makes a procedure schedulable.
